newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan seven-day NCDs average yield at 6.083 pct.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan seven-day NCDs average yield at 6.083 pct.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank on Monday issued T$3.0 billion in seven-day negotiable certificates of deposit at an average yield of 6.083 percent to mop up excess reserve in the banking system.
The range of the bids was between 5.903 and 6.148 percent, a central bank official said. Demand totalled T$4 billion.

Another bank official said the T$3 billion issue, relatively light compared to the heavy mop-up measures earlier in March, had taken into consideration the current peak payment period in the banking system.
